content.body: A Knowledge Base (also known as a Workspace) is a container for Memory Nodes and Edges, corresponding to an independent knowledge domain or project. Each user can create multiple knowledge bases. The knowledge base itself has a sharing tier (public / restricted / private), which is independent of node visibility—effective access permissions take the more restrictive of the two. A knowledge base can start from scratch, or bootstrap from a document with nodes extracted by AI. ID format: `ws_<hex8>`.
